{{Quote|There's a ''sun'' ahead&hellip; with a planet still intact!''"<br />"''The ''heart'' of the Red Nebula, smuggler. Our destination&hellip; and our ''target''.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Klysk]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 50">[[Star Wars (1977) 50|''Star Wars'' (1977) 50]]</ref>}}
The '''Red Nebula system''' was the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that incorporated a red [[Sun of the Planet of the Red Nebula|sun]] and the sole inhabited [[Planet of the Red Nebula|planet]] in the [[Red Nebula/Legends|Red Nebula]].
